Subject: POC trial planning - Clearlake Health

Hi Olivia / Ben —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery + proposed next steps for the POC/trial so we have clear success criteria, owners, and timeline. Please confirm or flag changes.

1) Success criteria (proposal)
- Avg inference latency <= 250ms p95 for 1k concurrent users
- Token cost under $0.0009/token for the evaluation workload
- No functional regressions on our evaluation prompts (see attached)
- Integration with your internal app (staging) to validate end-to-end UX

2) Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (prep): exchange data access and whitelisted IPs; Redwood provides a quick-setup guide
- Week 1-2: Baseline runs and smoke tests (profile latency/cost)
- Week 3-4: Full workload run and acceptance testing against success criteria

3) Timeline (tentative)
- Prep kickoff: target Jul 7 — agree on network & security contacts by Jul 5
- Start trial: Jul 12
- Acceptance decision: Jul 30

4) Ownership / RACI (high level)
- Redwood: provisioning, model serving, monitoring (Lauren lead)
- Clearlake App team: integration tests, UX validation (Olivia lead)
- Clearlake Security: SOC2/compliance checks and data handling approvals
- Procurement: contract & PO (Ben / procurement@clearlakehealth.org)

5) Next steps (action items)
- Olivia: confirm SOC2 reviewer + procurement lead (due Jul 5)
- Ben: confirm PO timing and procurement checklist (due Jul 6)
- Lauren: will send the RACI + setup guide and an infra checklist (by EOD Jul 3)
- Aditya: will own success criteria monitoring and provide a measurement dashboard during the trial
- Marissa (me): coordinate kickoff call and follow ups; share HubSpot link + MSA draft

Attachments: Clearlake-POC-RACI.xlsx; POC-success-criteria.docx

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks for the notes, Olivia —

Quick answers on infra and security touchpoints from the SRE/SE side:

- RACI (short):
  * Provisioning: Redwood (Lauren lead) — we spin up dedicated trial capacity within our hosted environment; we can also provide a VPC peering option if you prefer network isolation.
  * Integration / App tests: Clearlake app team (Olivia lead) — we provide API endpoints + SDKs for staging.
  * Security review: Clearlake Security (review) + Redwood Security (provide SOC2 & docs)
  * Network/IP allowlist: Clearlake infra (allowlist) / Redwood will provide the IP list and TLS certs.

- For SOC2 requests: please send the request to security@redwoodinference.com — I'll copy them on the initial email and attach our SOC2 summary.

- Data access approach:
  * Option A (fastest): Clearlake sends a sanitized test dataset to our secure ingestion for staging; we never persist PII and we’ll provide a short retention policy.
  * Option B (isolated): VPC peering + your CI/CD pulls to your staging instance; requires network setup (adds ~3 days).

I've attached a short quick-setup guide and will follow up with the RACI spreadsheet by EOD.

Attachments: redwood-quick-setup-guide.pdf

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
